statement: Build a single-file portfolio website for Ananya Rao, a wedding photographer in Jaipur, with a photo gallery, packages and prices, testimonials, and an enquiry form for wedding dates. Facts only the Requester can supply appear as visibly marked placeholders in one editable block.
audience: Couples and families looking to hire a wedding photographer in Jaipur.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file; CDN libraries are allowed; no build step.
Every placeholder (image, price, testimonial, form endpoint) is visibly labelled on the page and held in one editable list or constant.
rules: Sample prices must show the label 'sample, replace before launch'.
Each sample testimonial must carry a visible 'sample' label so it cannot pass as a real review.
Placeholder gallery images must be visibly labelled as placeholders.
The form delivery endpoint is a single clearly marked placeholder, flagged on the page as a launch blocker.
Do not invent facts about Ananya (contact details, accounts, awards, client names) beyond the brief.
done_when: The site is one HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, needs no build step, and names Ananya Rao and Jaipur.
A gallery section renders multiple images from one editable list, and each image is visibly labelled as a placeholder.
A testimonials section renders from one editable list, and each testimonial carries a visible 'sample' label.
An enquiry form has a wedding date field, a name field and a contact field, validates them before submit, and shows a confirmation message after a valid submit.
The form's delivery endpoint is one named placeholder constant, and the page shows a visible note that enquiries are not delivered until it is set.
open_inputs: Form delivery endpoint (for example an email or form-service address) so enquiries reach Ananya; launch blocker.
Real rate card: package names, inclusions and prices.
A packages and prices section renders multiple packages from one editable list, and each price carries the visible label 'sample, replace before launch'.
